pages.title: Candy Jewels
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Swap sweets into matching groups in Candy Jewels. Make lines of at least three candies to clear the board's targets, break chests, and collect coins as you progress through the levels. Boosters help with difficult arrangements, while missions and events such as Time Attack and Coin Catch give you other objectives to pursue. Look for combinations that advance the objective for the current stage.

pages.title: Football Legends 2026
pages.creator: MadPuffers
pages.description:
Football Legends 2026 turns soccer into short arcade matches with special-powered players. Play solo or with friends in 1v1 and 2v2 formats, using jumps, slides, regular shots, and supershots to finish with more goals before time expires. Character abilities include powerful kicks and teleportation, and tournaments give you a competition to work through.

Move with A and D or the left and right arrows, jump with W or Up, and slide with S or Down. X or L takes a shot, while Z or K triggers the supershot. Timing your movement and attacks helps you create an opening in front of goal.

pages.title: Dragon Draw Joust
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Draw equipment that becomes part of your fighter in Dragon Draw Joust. Click and drag to sketch a tool, then use the resulting creation to help the warrior block attacks or strike an opponent in the arena. The shape you design is part of the combat setup, so think about both protection and reach when preparing for the next encounter.

pages.title: Fluffy Mania
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Link same-colored creatures into chains in Fluffy Mania. Click a fluffy animal and drag through others of its color, then release to complete the connection. Longer chains earn more points, giving you a reason to search beyond the first small group you notice. Complete each level's objective to advance through the increasingly demanding layouts, using a mouse or swiping controls.

pages.title: Fruit Jam - Merge Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Minor Bugs
pages.description: Sort colorful fruit into matching groups in Fruit Jam - Merge Puzzle Game. Select a fruit to move it from the layout into the sorting area, then bring matching colors together to complete a combination. Work through the changing fruit arrangements and clear the goals for each level. The game also includes daily rewards as you continue through its puzzles.

pages.title: Draw To Crush : Monster Game
pages.creator: Games Fort Studios
pages.description: Turn a sketch into a weapon in Draw To Crush : Monster Game. Draw a line or shape that becomes a three-dimensional tool for destroying the monster in the puzzle. Friendly animals and a clown also need saving, so consider how your creation affects the whole scene. Each drawing changes the outcome, making the design of the shape part of solving the level.

pages.title: Rope Sorting
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Organize colored ropes onto spools in Rope Sorting. Take rope from the top of a coil, working with one color per turn, and combine matching colors until the spools are filled correctly. Empty coils provide space for separating a mixed arrangement. You can undo a step when you want another approach, or add an empty coil to give yourself more room to sort.

pages.title: Granny GTA Vegas
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Play an armed Granny on the neon streets of Las Vegas in Granny GTA Vegas. Red-hooded, masked enemies pursue her through the city's alleys and casino districts, and shooting back is central to getting through the encounters. Use the mouse controls to handle the action as Granny faces the attackers. The game puts its horror character into a city-shootout setting.

pages.title: Parkour Block 7
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Cross another set of block-built courses in Parkour Block 7. Run and jump through the levels, judging where to move next as you work through their platforming challenges. WASD moves your character, Space jumps, and Left Shift runs. Press Escape twice to return to the menu. Touch controls are also available, giving you another way to handle the course's movement and jumps.

pages.title: Merge Car Defense
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Build a stronger vehicle defense in Merge Car Defense. Combine and upgrade cars to prepare a roster that can fight successive enemy waves. Use the mouse to swipe through the upgrade actions, then put the improved cars to work against the attackers. Defeating enemies brings coins as you continue developing the fleet and choosing how to use it in battle.

pages.title: Parking Fury 3D: Night City
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Navigate a city after dark in Parking Fury 3D: Night City. Take on driving assignments involving vehicles such as taxis and ambulances, or complete missions that require taking a particular car. The minimap's arrows guide you toward the destination. Drive with the arrow keys and press Ctrl to enter a vehicle, switching between the cars needed for the different jobs.

pages.title: Funny Fever Hospital
pages.creator: CGSpot
pages.description: Help Ruby get ready for a cosplay competition through two connected activities in Funny Fever Hospital. Begin with the hospital stage, carrying out the game's examination and operation tasks for her lung illness. Once treatment is finished, move on to selecting her cosplay look. Use the left mouse button for both the medical-simulation actions and the dress-up choices.

pages.title: Tapus Skating Adventure
pages.creator: Neela Mediatech Private Limited
pages.description: Help a skateboarder collect coins and pull off tricks in Tapus Skating Adventure. Time an ollie to carry Tappu through the run without crashing, using Space on a computer or tapping the screen on a phone. Letters along the route add a bonus to the score. Watch the next stretch of the course and choose when to jump for the pickups ahead.

pages.title: Darts King
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Compete at the dartboard and move up through leagues in Darts King. Aim for valuable sections of the target to outscore your opponents, working on accuracy from one game to the next. Upgrades let you improve the darts and assemble a set of your own. The competition combines precise throwing with developing your equipment as you progress through the leagues.

pages.title: Chibi Idol Party
pages.creator: ales
pages.description: Gather a following and style your performer in Chibi Idol Party. Move with the mouse or touch controls to collect fans at parties, earning starcoins that can be spent on your idol's appearance. Costumes, accessories, makeup, and hairstyles give you ways to change the look. Continue gathering fans and use the rewards to build a different pop-idol outfit.

pages.title: Bubble Buster HD
pages.creator: Andrew Wolf
pages.description:
Clear colored bubbles from the ceiling in Bubble Buster HD. Fire from the bottom of the screen and connect at least three matching bubbles to remove the group. Bubbles left without a connection to the roof or another attached bubble fall away too, and shots can rebound from the side walls.

Choose an arcade or random-board mode, with either a time-based or turn-based format. The arcade selection includes 100 designed levels, giving you fixed arrangements to work through alongside the random layouts.

pages.title: Yasin Poop Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Race for the bathroom in Yasin Poop Rush. Obstacles and riddles stand between you and relief, and you need to work through them before the timer runs out. Use the keyboard arrows on a computer or the on-screen buttons on a phone to guide the action. The urgent journey mixes route hazards with comic surprises as you try to reach the destination in time.

pages.title: Fireworks Maker Simulator Bang
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Put together a virtual celebration in Fireworks Maker Simulator Bang. Create and launch fireworks, set off firecrackers, and choose a festive environment for the display. Use the mouse on a computer or tap the screen on a phone to handle the selections. Try different fireworks as you build a show around the bright explosions and holiday setting.

pages.title: Down the Hill
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Choose your next step down a hazardous slope in Down the Hill. Move left or right to guide the character farther downhill, collecting coins and keeping clear of dangerous ground and obstacles. Use the left and right arrow keys, or click or tap the corresponding half of the screen. Each step changes your position on the hill as you try to extend the run.

pages.title: Mr. Noob EAT Burger
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Search an estate for burgers without getting caught in Mr. Noob EAT Burger. A torch and burger detector help you find the food, but Mr. Noob guards the place and threatens your escape. Collect every burger while avoiding him. Move with WASD, look around with the mouse, and press E to use an item. Number keys switch the inventory, and Escape pauses the game.

pages.title: Rescue from Rainbow Monster Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Free a trapped character by cutting its tether in Rescue from Rainbow Monster Online. Study the puzzle's arrangement and decide where to cut the rope to release the character. On a computer, use the mouse to make the cut; on a touchscreen, tap and slide across the rope. Work through the rescue puzzles by choosing the cut that lets the captive get free.

pages.title: Cooking Mania Express
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Manage the kitchen's order of work in Cooking Mania Express. Prepare ingredients, cook meals, and serve the customers arriving at your restaurant, using the mouse to handle the tasks. Choosing what to do next matters when several jobs need attention. Keep the food moving from preparation to service so you can satisfy the customers and continue growing the business.

pages.title: Crazy Laundry
pages.creator: OneTwoPlay IT
pages.description: Help Mike turn cleaning day into a series of different tasks in Crazy Laundry. Repair pipes, clean a mirror, and then head inside the washing machine to fight the microbes there. The game combines ordinary household jobs with a small-scale battle inside the appliance. Work through the cleaning and repair challenges as Mike takes on each part of the laundry-day adventure.

pages.title: Help the couple
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Reunite two characters by rebuilding their route in Help the couple. Click and drag the sliding pieces into position until they form a way for the pair to meet. Moving one section changes the space available for the others, so plan the arrangement before shifting tiles at random. The game includes 30 levels with different paths to put together.

pages.title: Star Maze
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Roll through a maze, paint its tiles, and gather stars in Star Maze. Swipe to move the ball along the passages, choosing a route that reaches every star in the level. Your movement colors the maze as you travel. The game contains 100 layouts to work through, giving you another set of corridors and pickups to plan around after each puzzle.

pages.title: Prison Noob vs Pro
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide two escaped prisoners toward an elevator in Prison Noob vs Pro. Noob is the one who can collect diamonds, while Pro alone can open the doors, so both characters have a part in clearing the route. Rising water adds pressure to reach the lift in time. Use WASD and the arrow keys, or the mobile touch controls, and take advantage of double jumps to cross the underground obstacles.

pages.title: Hamster Stack Maze
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Guide a hungry hamster through puzzle layouts in Hamster Stack Maze. Gather food along the route and work through the tasks needed to finish each maze. Use the mouse or tap controls to handle the hamster's movement through the different levels. Look through the paths before moving so you can reach the food and continue toward completing the current stage.

pages.title: Fashion Superstar Dress Them
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Create outfits and character looks for judging in Fashion Superstar Dress Them. Customize features such as skin tone, hair, eyes, lips, and makeup, then choose the clothing and accessories for the model. A panel of in-game influencers scores the finished style. High scores earn diamonds that can unlock more outfits, giving you additional pieces to try for the next judged look.

pages.title: Cats Rotate
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Rebuild a cat picture by turning its pieces in Cats Rotate. Tap or click a section to rotate it, then compare it with the neighboring parts of the image. Your goal is to align the pieces into the correct picture before the timer expires. Keep checking the whole cat illustration as you adjust the remaining sections into place.

pages.title: Jimmy Bubblegum
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Float into an airborne fight in Jimmy Bubblegum. Jimmy's oversized bubble carries him upward while enemies, including balloons with knives attached, threaten his climb. Fight the attackers as the ascent continues and keep the bubble's passenger clear of danger. Weapon hotkeys can be configured from the main menu's settings screen, and P pauses the game when you need a break.

pages.title: New Year Party Challenge
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Prepare two different royal celebrations in New Year Party Challenge. Decorate the palace and choose outfits that fit each princess's holiday theme. Eliza's preparations feature a festive tree, gifts, garlands, and sparkling party looks, while the Chinese princess's celebration brings red and gold styling into the mix. Use the mouse or touchscreen to put together the decorations and clothing for their New Year challenge.

pages.title: impostor Crab
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help a burger-loving crab cross dangerous stages in impostor Crab. Collect hamburgers for points, overcome the enemies on the route, and reach the finish flag. Use WASD to move and take advantage of the double jump when you need extra height. Landing on monsters can defeat them, giving you a way to handle the creatures blocking the path as the levels become harder.

pages.title: Human Vehicle
pages.creator: Nepix
pages.description: Turn a growing group of stick figures into vehicles in Human Vehicle. Slide to steer along the course, collecting more people to form different vehicle shapes while avoiding the obstacles ahead. Gems collected during the run can be spent on new vehicles. Tap to begin, then choose a route that brings in more stickmen and keeps the group moving through the stage.

pages.title: Rocket Pants Runner 3D
pages.creator: Drmop Games
pages.description: Run through a three-dimensional obstacle course in Rocket Pants Runner 3D. Jump, swerve, dash, and move through driving sections while picking up food along the route. The endless run gives you hazards to avoid as you try to keep going. Choose from 20 characters, including a granny, firefighter, police officer, elf, and Santa, before heading into another attempt.

pages.title: Solitaire Social
pages.creator: Drmop Games
pages.description:
Play Klondike with extra ways to manage a difficult deal in Solitaire Social. Choose a normal game or a relaxed layout with every card face up, then move cards toward completing the suit foundations. Random and winnable deals offer different starting choices. Undo, hints, autocomplete, and a card-steal aid can help when a hand becomes awkward.

The history keeps previous games available to revisit, including losses you want to try again. Statistics and daily quests track further goals, while 16 card decks and 18 backgrounds let you change the table's appearance. Use the mouse or touchscreen to handle the cards.

pages.title: Spiral Roll 2
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Roll wood into a projectile in Spiral Roll 2. Hold the mouse button or keep a finger down to build the roll, then release to send it forward. Use the launched wood to remove saws and other obstacles on the route. Work through each level's barriers and try to reach the bonus waiting at the end of the course.

pages.title: OvO
pages.creator: Dedra
pages.description: Move through demanding platform courses as quickly as you can in OvO. Learn the character's movement techniques, use them to clear the levels, and collect the coins scattered along the routes. Easy and hard modes offer different challenges, with skins and achievements available to unlock. The arrow keys handle movement, and the controls can be changed to suit how you prefer to play.

pages.title: Fabulous Dressup Royal Day Out
pages.creator: Lazy Bird Games
pages.description: Help a princess prepare for a summer outing in Fabulous Dressup Royal Day Out. Choose her makeup and assemble an outfit for the day, trying different combinations from the available styling options. Click or tap to make each selection and see how it changes her appearance. The makeover brings the cosmetics and clothing together into the finished look she will wear outside.

pages.title: City Minibus Driver
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Take passengers around a busy city in City Minibus Driver. Career assignments require reaching the route's stops on time, while racing tournaments offer another way to earn money. Spend the proceeds on faster or more luxurious minibuses in the garage. Fuel, tire trouble, and an unclean bus can also interrupt the job, adding vehicle upkeep to the driving.

Use WASD to steer, Space for the handbrake, and C to change the camera. Single-player also accepts the arrow keys. A second player's controls use the arrows and Right Shift, letting two drivers take part on the same keyboard.

pages.title: Draw Knife
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Sketch the route of a blade in Draw Knife. Draw a trajectory, aim the shot, and send the knife toward its target while keeping it clear of collisions. The puzzle is to choose a path that reaches the destination through the available space. Look at the obstacles before drawing so the knife has a clear route when you fire.

pages.title: ev.io
pages.creator: Addicting Games
pages.description: Enter futuristic first-person firefights in ev.io. Join public ranked games or create a private game with friends, using your performance to earn in-game currency for skins and other cosmetic items. WASD moves your character, Space jumps, T performs a melee attack, and G throws a grenade. Right-click aims or zooms, and the hotkeys can be configured to fit your preferred controls.

pages.title: Turn Me On
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Get a small red button into its box in Turn Me On. Click to interact with the button and the objects around it, using the platform's arrangement to guide it toward the destination. Gears along the route add to your score if you collect them. Study which objects can help before triggering the next part of the button's journey.

pages.title: Moto Racer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Race computer-controlled riders to the finish in Moto Racer. Choose a motorcycle from the garage, collect coins during the levels, and use upgrades to improve the bike for later races. The goal is to cross the finish line ahead of the other riders. Guide the motorcycle with the arrow keys as you work through the courses and develop your garage selection.

pages.title: Light Police Speed Hero Robot Rescue Mission
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Take on futuristic rescue assignments in Light Police Speed Hero Robot Rescue Mission. Play a robot hero sent to help people in trouble, moving through the missions to reach the current rescue objective. Use the keyboard arrows to control the action as you work through the assignments. The game centers on the robot's response duties and completing the rescue tasks ahead.

pages.title: Pocket Racing
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Take unusual vehicles across rough courses in Pocket Racing. Ride a motorbike or try a wheelchair, tractor, quadricycle, or scooter as you work through 60 off-road levels. Obstacles give you chances to leave the ground, making the vehicle's rotation part of handling the course. Accelerate, brake, and adjust your angle with the keyboard arrows or the on-screen touch controls.

pages.title: Easy Kids Coloring Tractor
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fill tractor outlines with color in Easy Kids Coloring Tractor. Choose one of the uncolored tractor pictures, select shades, and use the mouse or tap controls to decorate the illustration. Try different combinations as you decide how the vehicle should look. When the design is finished, take a picture of the result to keep a record of your artwork.

pages.title: Funny Forest
pages.creator: Xpresate Studio
pages.description: Feed forest animals by making fruit matches in Funny Forest. Drag fruit into groups of three or more of the same kind, looking for the favorites requested by the animals. Fulfilling their food needs lets you move forward. Match choices matter because each animal wants a particular fruit, so focus on the current request as you work through the board.

pages.title: Stickman Armed Assassin Going Down
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Survive a large shootout as a stick figure in Stickman Armed Assassin Going Down. Move around the third-person battlefield, fire at enemies, and switch into bullet time to slow the action. Ragdoll physics affect the characters during the fighting.

Use WASD to move, the mouse to aim and fire, R to reload, and T for bullet time. Space jumps, Left Shift sprints, G throws a grenade, and V performs a melee attack, giving you several ways to handle close and distant threats.

pages.title: Extreme Impossible Bike Track Stunt Challenge 2020
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Take on timed motorcycle courses in Extreme Impossible Bike Track Stunt Challenge 2020. Ride through the track and complete its stunt challenge before the allotted time runs out. The levels put the emphasis on controlling the bike while keeping up enough speed to finish. Look ahead along the course and manage the approach to its stunt sections during each attempt.

pages.title: Cut Fruit
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Cut fruit for points while keeping your blade away from bombs in Cut Fruit. Use mouse or touch controls to slice as much produce as possible, checking what is on screen before committing to another cut. Three modes provide different ways to take on the fruit-slicing challenge. Keep the cuts focused on fruit so a bomb does not interrupt the attempt.

pages.title: Teddy Escape
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: A jetpack-wearing bear is trapped in a circular chase in Teddy Escape. A jet fighter follows the same orbit, and you need to change the bear's direction to avoid colliding with it. Click or tap to manage the chase as both characters gain speed. The longer it continues, the less time you have to judge when another direction change is needed.

pages.title: Virus Hunter
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Pilot a small plane against moving virus targets in Virus Hunter. Use mouse or touch-and-drag controls to guide the aircraft and line up its shots with the enemies entering the field. The action focuses on shooting the viruses and building your score as you continue through the attack. Keep adjusting the plane's position to bring the next target into its firing path.

pages.title: Corona Virus Attack
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Capture space around moving enemies in Corona Virus Attack. Use the arrow keys to travel along the screen's border, then hold Space to draw a line through the open area. Close off sections until you have claimed the percentage required for the level. While a line is being drawn, the viruses can attack both the character and the unfinished trail, so judge their positions before leaving the border.

pages.title: TrafficControl.io
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Keep an intersection moving without collisions in TrafficControl.io. Click or tap individual cars to stop them, then select them again when it is safe to continue. Watch how the routes cross before releasing another vehicle into the traffic. The pace becomes more demanding as the game continues, giving you more movements to coordinate while trying to prevent the next crash.

pages.title: Pill Soccer
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Jump and kick your way through compact football duels in Pill Soccer. Try Quick Play or a tournament, or choose the two-player option for a match with a friend. Position your character to send the ball toward the opposing goal while covering your own side. The first player can use the arrows to move and jump, P or Down to kick, and K for the super bonus.

pages.title: Bff Broadway Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Mia and Bella get ready for an evening event in Bff Broadway Party. Browse the dresses and choose an elegant outfit for each friend before they head to the party. Use the mouse to try the clothing options and compare how the different choices look. The activity focuses on dressing the two characters for their Broadway-themed celebration.

pages.title: Ninja Pumpkin
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Run through ten platforming stages in Ninja Pumpkin. Use Up to jump and Down to slide, or select the corresponding on-screen buttons to get through the route. Coins provide another goal along the way: every 30 collected awards an extra life. Time left at the end of a level contributes to the final score, giving you a reason to keep moving while gathering coins.

pages.title: TopDown Monster Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight to stay alive from an overhead view in TopDown Monster Shooter. Move with WASD and fire with the left mouse button, keeping the monsters in your sights as you reposition around them. The game tracks kills and survival performance, with a best result to improve after an attempt ends. Balance firing with movement so the character can keep fighting longer.

pages.title: Chipolino Another Day
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Guide the runner through traps and obstacles in Chipolino Another Day. Run and jump to keep the character clear of danger, then collect health pickups if you take damage along the route. Use the arrow, mouse, or touch controls to play. The goal is to keep the run going, choosing safer jumps and restoring health when a pickup becomes available.

pages.title: 911 Ambulance Doctor
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Prepare equipment and look after injured patients in 911 Ambulance Doctor. Pack and check the medical tools, then use them in the game's treatment activities to help the people brought to your care. Mouse or tap controls handle the hospital-simulation tasks. Work through the equipment preparation and patient-care steps as you take on another emergency case.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Spa Bath
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Give Hazel a themed bath and makeover in Baby Hazel Spa Bath. Gather ingredients from the kitchen to prepare the bath mixtures, then work through milk, chocolate, and cherry bubble-bath activities. Keep an eye on Hazel's needs so she stays happy during the session. Finish by choosing clothing and accessories, using the mouse to interact throughout the bath and dress-up stages.

pages.title: Spend My Dubai Holiday
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Prepare Daisy for a day of sightseeing in Spend My Dubai Holiday. She is on a family trip and wants an outfit for exploring and taking photographs. Use the mouse to browse her wardrobe, try different combinations, and decide what she should wear for the outing. The holiday setting gives you a theme for putting together her finished look.

pages.title: Bottle Tap
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Pop bottles to collect stars in Bottle Tap. Click a bottle to send its cap into the scene, using the direction of the launch to reach the stars placed around the level. Look at the arrangement before choosing a bottle to open and judge where the cap will travel. Collect the required stars to finish the stage and continue to the next puzzle.

pages.title: TM Driver
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Take on driving assignments across a large map in TM Driver. Complete missions to work toward joining a racing crew, unlocking more cars as you succeed. The new vehicles give you other choices for the challenges ahead. Drive with the arrow keys, use Space to brake, and press B to look behind as you work through the mission routes.

pages.title: Icing On The Cake
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Decorate cakes with colored cream in Icing On The Cake. Use the mouse or tap controls to apply icing, either experimenting with a design of your own or following the order's example. Matching the requested appearance helps unlock more cake molds, giving you additional shapes to decorate. Study the reference when you want to work toward those new options.

pages.title: Kids And Cat Differences
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Compare pictures of children and cats in Kids And Cat Differences. Each of the ten levels has seven small changes to locate, with one minute available to finish the search. Click or tap a detail when you find something that does not match between the images. Check different parts of the scene as you work through the remaining differences before the timer expires.

pages.title: Moto City Stunt
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Choose a motorcycle and explore a stunt-filled city in Moto City Stunt. The free-play setting contains ramps and loops where you can try jumps and other maneuvers without following a fixed race route. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, use Space for the handbrake, and press C to change the camera. Pick a route through the city and line up the next stunt you want to attempt.

pages.title: Impossible Bike Racing 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle along tracks suspended in the air in Impossible Bike Racing 3D. Follow the course carefully, slowing down for sharp turns before attempting the next stretch or stunt. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, Shift for nitro, and R to restart. Balance speed with steering as you work through the risky elevated routes.

pages.title: Toyota Prius Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble photographs of the Toyota Prius in Toyota Prius Puzzle. Choose from six car pictures, then select a puzzle size of 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the mouse to put the pieces together and restore the complete image. Changing the piece count lets you return to the same picture with a more detailed puzzle to solve.

pages.title: Highway Traffic Bike Stunts
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take on motorcycle missions in Highway Traffic Bike Stunts. The assignments include close passes through traffic and jumps over a train, combining road riding with stunt challenges. Steer with A and D, press W to boost, and use Space to create a ramp. Check the current mission's goal and position the bike for the maneuver it requires.

pages.title: Snow Drift
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Slide a car through snowy stages in Snow Drift. Drive with WASD, steering across the snow to clear it and work toward finishing the level. The game tracks the remaining snow as you progress, with further stages ahead after a successful clear. A garage also offers cars to select and unlock for more driving attempts.

pages.title: EG Professor Bubble
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Aim colored shots at matching bubbles in EG Professor Bubble. Form a group of at least three balls of one color to make a match and build your score. Use the mouse or touch controls to direct each shot. Look for useful color connections before firing so the next bubble can join a matching group.

pages.title: Ball Racer
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Guide a rolling ball to the finish in Ball Racer. Hold the mouse button to steer right and release it to steer left, timing each change to follow the route. More than 50 levels offer courses to work through with this hold-and-release control. Read the next bend before changing direction and try to carry the ball all the way to the endpoint.

pages.title: Swat vs Zombies
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Face a zombie outbreak as a lone fighter in Swat vs Zombies. Work through five increasingly difficult levels and visit the store to buy from 16 weapon types. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, fire with Space, and reload with R. Keep the character moving while lining up shots against the zombies blocking the advance.

pages.title: Temple Quest
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Escape through ancient ruins after stealing an artifact in Temple Quest. This endless runner sends you past obstacles while you gather golden idols, coins, and power-ups. Complete objectives to increase the score multiplier and upgrade power-ups to help future runs. Different outfits provide special abilities, giving you another choice to consider while trying to extend the escape and improve your distance.

pages.title: Cube City Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Drive block-shaped cars through a cubic world in Cube City Racing. Explore freely in traffic or try the other driving modes, playing alone or sharing the game with a second player. The first player steers with WASD, while the second uses the arrow keys. Choose a car and decide whether to roam through the city or take on a mode's challenge.

pages.title: Virus
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Choose when to release an antibody in Virus. Click or touch a virus on the bottom row to spawn an antibody, aiming to neutralize the infection with as few moves as possible. Timing matters as well as the number of actions you use. Watch the situation before selecting your next move and try to solve it more efficiently.

pages.title: Base Defense
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Recruit soldiers and push back a zombie assault in Base Defense. Spend gold on available unit icons, earning more by defeating enemies or waiting. Your population limit grows during play, allowing a larger force. Protect your own base while sending units toward the opposing base; draining its health bar wins the battle.

Rage builds automatically and can be spent on super attacks. Winning levels again earns crystals for upgrades, including health, damage, and speed. Decide when to recruit another soldier and when to use a special attack to support the advance.

pages.title: Whack a Mole
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Strike the moles as they emerge from their holes in Whack a Mole. Click a visible mole before it ducks underground, then look for the next target as more appear. The game records your score and best result, giving you a total to improve. Watch the holes closely so you can react while a mole is still above ground.

pages.title: Fishing
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Work the fishing line to bring in a bigger catch in Fishing. Piranhas can eat fish you have hooked, so watch for them as you try to bring your catch up safely. Each fish caught adds time, helping the session continue. Keep gathering fish while protecting them from the piranhas and watching the remaining time.

pages.title: Monster Truck Hidden Star
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Search monster-truck pictures for concealed stars in Monster Truck Hidden Star. Find every star in the current scene to open the next level. There is no time limit, so you can study each part of the picture at your own pace. Select the stars as you spot them and keep checking the scene for any that remain.

pages.title: EG Mini Car
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Choose a small racing car and take to the tracks in EG Mini Car. Try Race Mode or Time Trial, with different courses and cars to explore. More vehicles can be unlocked as you play, expanding the selection for later attempts. Pick a car and track, then work on your racing performance or try to improve a timed run.

pages.title: EG Bus Parking
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Maneuver a bus into its parking position in EG Bus Parking. Guide the large vehicle into place and line it up with the target space to complete the parking task. The game displays a current time and best time, providing a result to compare on another attempt. Concentrate on steering and final placement as you practice the route.

pages.title: Happy Helloween
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Catch falling sweets in Happy Helloween. Watch the candy descend and try to collect as much as you can without missing it. The Halloween-themed game centers on this candy-catching challenge, giving you a simple goal to return to: improving the amount you manage to gather.

pages.title: Piano Tile Reflex
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Test your tapping speed in Piano Tile Reflex by selecting black tiles and avoiding white ones. Three modes change the task: Pattern asks you to clear the displayed patterns, while Frenzy gives you 30 seconds to hit as many black tiles as possible. In Endurance, every 40 black tiles adds ten seconds to the clock. Keep making correct selections to prevent the time from running out.

pages.title: Checkers
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Plan diagonal moves and captures in Checkers. Play against the computer or choose a match with a friend, starting with 12 pieces on each side. Ordinary pieces advance one square diagonally forward, and the goal is to take all opposing pieces or leave the opponent without a legal move. Consider how each move changes the spaces available to both sides before committing a piece.

pages.title: Car Rush
pages.creator: webofgrafix
pages.description: Keep a police pursuit going in Car Rush. Drive and drift to evade the chasing vehicles, avoiding contact as you look for a way to stay out of their reach. The objective is to escape being caught for as long as you can. Watch the pursuit and change your route when the cars close in.

pages.title: Coachella Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Prepare Sally's festival look in Coachella Hairstyles. Start with her hair, choosing among braided styles, buns, and loose boho curls. Try different dye combinations, then add details such as glitter, hairpins, or a floral headband to finish the hairstyle. Once her hair is ready, choose an outfit for the music festival. Match the clothing and hair accessories to put together the look you want her to wear.

pages.title: Princess New Year Love Story
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Dress Ariel for two outings in Princess New Year Love Story. Begin with an outfit for meeting her friends at a cafe, where a conversation with a boy may lead to an evening date. Then choose a look for the romantic occasion, comparing a simple dress with a more glamorous style. The story gives each dress-up stage its own setting as Ariel starts her New Year.

pages.title: Christmas Castle
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Make seasonal matches to keep the clock running in Christmas Castle. Drag Christmas items into lines containing at least three of the same kind. Larger matches, up to five in a row, create special bonuses. Every successful match adds time, so look for the next combination before the remaining time runs out and try to keep the sequence going.

pages.title: Princess Sweater Weather
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style Rapunzel, Merida, Cinderella, and Ariel in Princess Sweater Weather. Explore knitted tops and layering options to create an outfit for each princess. Rapunzel's choices include off-shoulder sweaters, while Merida can combine knitwear with jeans and tall boots. Try a long sweater with leggings for Cinderella or a shirt, knitted vest, and skirt for Ariel. Finish each combination with shoes that suit the clothing you picked.

pages.title: Virus Attack
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Enclose parts of the playfield in Virus Attack while moving viruses threaten your character and drawn lines. Travel around the border with the arrow keys, then hold Space to extend a line into the open area. Finish an enclosure to claim more territory. Reach the percentage shown for the stage to clear it, watching the enemies before starting another vulnerable, unfinished line.

pages.title: Princess Dab Queens
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Combine dress-up and a growing dance sequence in Princess Dab Queens. Select two contestants and choose dresses, heels, and jewelry for them before the competition begins. Watch one princess perform, then click the left or right arrow to make the other copy her moves. The sequence becomes longer as you progress. Correct moves earn gold coins that can unlock additional fashion items.

pages.title: Pyramid Solitaire
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Remove the card pyramid by making pairs worth 13 in Pyramid Solitaire. Select cards with the mouse or a finger, combining their values to clear them from the layout. A king counts as 13 and can be removed on its own. Deal from the stock when you need another option, keeping in mind that stock passes are limited. Look for pairs that help you continue clearing the pyramid.

pages.title: Killer Saw
pages.creator: Cosmity
pages.description: Guide two characters down past moving blades in Killer Saw. Use the one-touch controls to lower the pair toward the food at the bottom without letting the saws cut them. Getting both characters safely to the goal unlocks another pair and its level. There are four levels to work through, each requiring you to judge when it is safe to descend.

pages.title: Nut Rush
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Help a squirrel gather nuts among the treetops in Nut Rush. Jump between branches to reach the nuts along the route, taking care to land safely and avoid falling. Judge the gaps before each leap and keep collecting as you move through the trees. The challenge combines gathering the nuts with keeping the squirrel on the branches.

pages.title: Princesses Cooking Contest
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help two princesses decorate donuts for a competition in Princesses Cooking Contest. Choose chocolate, candies, and sweet syrups to give their entries a finished appearance. Combine the available toppings and compare the designs as you prepare both contestants' donuts. The activity focuses on decorating the treats for the contest, with the aim of creating a winning presentation.

pages.title: Dove Pinup Dolly Dress Up
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Give Dove a vintage-inspired makeover in Dove Pinup Dolly Dress Up. Combine pinup tops and bottoms, then choose a hairstyle to complete the outfit. The game rates finished looks with up to five stars and includes achievements to unlock. Try different clothing combinations as you work toward a five-star result and explore more of Dove's pinup wardrobe.

pages.title: Annie Winter Dress
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Create a festive outfit in Annie Winter Dress. Build the dress by choosing a top, skirt, and belt, comparing the pieces until they make the combination you want. Next, style Annie's hair and add accessories to complete her look. Pick a purse, high heels, and jewelry that work with the dress, giving her a finished outfit for the holiday party setting.
